title: Harshit Rana's Entry Steals The Show As India Test Stars Attend Dinner At Gautam Gambhir's House | Watch | Cricket News - News18
text: Gautam Gambhir hosted dinner for the members of the India Test squad including the support staff at his residence in New Delhi on Wednesday night. All the members of the Test team including captain Shubman Gill, vice-captain Ravindra Jadeja, pace spearhead Jasprit Bumrah among others were in attendance. While the Test squad arrived in a team, the entry of a certain Harshit Rana is going viral on social medial. Why? Because unlike other India players who arrived together in a bus, Rana drove to the head coach’s residence in a car. The answer is quite straightforward. Rana, who is based out of Delhi, is not part of the Indian Test squad and hence not staying with the members in the team hotel. Rana has been hitting the headlines for being picked in multiple India squads which has raised eyebrows. Former India opener Krishnamachari Srikkanth even claimed that the fast bowler seems to be the only “permanent member" of the Indian team given the constant changes. “There is only one permanent member – Harshit Rana. Nobody knows why he is there in the team," Srikkanth said following the announcement of India’s ODI squad for the upcoming tour of Australia. However, Aakash Chopra has defended Rana arguing it’s not the 24-year-old’s fault that he keeps getting picked. While advising to not troll the young fast bowler, Chopra wants him to be given more time to prove his credentials. “People are trolling this kid," Chopra said on his YouTube channel. “It’s not his fault that he gets picked in all squads. Anyone who plays for India gets picked by the selectors. Captain and coach also give inputs but don’t have the voting rights. If after that someone keeps getting picked, then it’s not that person’s fault. You are pointing your guns in the wrong direction."
